text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Champions Meeting"?! Suzuka, do you<n>know
what this is?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a new kind of tournament.<n>You match
with opponents in real time<n>and race for first
place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So it's a chance to compete with racers<n>from all
over the world... I can't wait to<n>get started!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! I'm gettin' excited for it too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Up to three runners can enter the<n>tournament, so
we have to get chosen<n>for it first.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Also, the tournament is split into<n>preliminaries
and finals!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so we're gonna hafta win the prelims<n>first
before we're allowed to run in the<n>finals!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time to show 'em who's boss!<n>Let's train
hard and give it our best,<n>Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're getting me all excited too.
